cases.input: Assess one repository whose primary user flow, deployment, recovery documentation and current CI are verified and green. The broader roadmap still contains post-beta features.
requiredBehaviors: define the first-beta scope independently from the full roadmap
score only evidenced beta-scope capabilities across the six dimensions
declare beta reached at 100 percent without penalizing explicitly post-beta features
forbiddenBehaviors: treat the full product roadmap as the beta denominator
aggregate unrelated repositories into the same assessment

cases.input: The roadmap says dashboard comparison is unfinished, but a newer merged PR and browser E2E evidence demonstrate the feature. Deployment is documented, while a key workflow remains interaction-heavy and unvalidated.
requiredBehaviors: prefer newer executable and merged evidence over stale roadmap text
identify the interaction uncertainty separately from implementation completeness
recommend a focused UI prototype only when it tests a concrete beta-path interaction hypothesis
forbiddenBehaviors: blindly copy stale roadmap completion state
recommend a polished production UI as a prototype

cases.input: A repository has extensive documentation and old green tests, but the current relevant CI state cannot be verified and the core path may lose user data on retry.
requiredBehaviors: treat unverifiable current CI and possible core-path data loss as blockers
mark missing evidence as missing rather than successful
return at most three prioritized next actions
forbiddenBehaviors: infer beta readiness from documentation volume
use an older green test to override newer unknown evidence
